comments.author: @anthonytascione3684
comments.text: My daughter lived around the corner from Sally’s and Pepe’s while doing her fellowship at Yale-New Haven Hospital. Each time we drove up to visit she would order a couple of pies on line for take out. As I recall 2-21/2 hour wait, but very organized with no drama. Having lived on Bleecker Street in Greenwich village I was used to and prefer a New York style pizza, but I liked the pizza from Sally’s and Modern.
